docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Le Bon's account of how people think and act in crowds, and of the beliefs that move them.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Gustave Le Bon (1841–1931), Psychologie des foules (1895), in the English translation published by T. Fisher Unwin, 1896 (the translator is not named). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
